title: Windows `Instant` is not monotonic due to neglecting the signedness of `QueryPerformanceCounter`
author: joboet
body_preview: The result of the `QueryPerformanceCounter` function used for `Instant` on Windows is a 64-bit *signed* integer that [may very well be negative](https://www.pouet.net/topic.php?which=12684). However, `std` does not currently handle negative return values at all, it immediately casts the return value into an unsigned integer: https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/blob/f28ac764c36004fa6a6e098d15b4016a83...
